common.connection: Connection settings are read from PGHOST, PGPORT, PGDATABASE, PGUSER and PGPASSWORD — see .env.example.

migrate.option_dry_run: List pending migrations without applying them.
migrate.option_lang: Print in this language (en or hi), whatever the store default is.

dry_run_summary.one: dry run: {count} migration would be applied
dry_run_summary.other: dry run: {count} migrations would be applied

migrate.unreachable: could not reach {target} — is Postgres running?

reconcile.description: Runs every check in reconciliation_checks and records the outcome. Exits 1 if any check reports drift or fails.
reconcile.option_lang: Print in this language (en or hi), whatever the store default is.
reconcile.unattended: {check} is {health} — nothing is running this check

catalogue.option_dry_run: Validate and report without writing anything.
catalogue.option_lang: Print in this language (en or hi), whatever the store default is.
catalogue.docs: See docs/catalogue-import.md, and docs/catalogue-template.csv for a starting file.
catalogue.no_file: no file given — name the CSV to import
catalogue.rejected_heading: rejected rows — line numbers match the spreadsheet:
catalogue.unreadable: the file could not be read: {detail}

bill.no_lines: A bill needs at least one line to be totalled.
bill.discount_invalid: Bill discount {amount} is not a positive amount.
bill.discount_exceeds_total: Bill discount {discount} is more than the bill's {total}.

line.qty_invalid: Line {line}: quantity must be more than zero.
line.rate_invalid: Line {line}: rate must be zero or more.
line.tax_rate_invalid: Line {line}: {tax} rate {rate} is not a valid rate.
line.igst_with_cgst: Line {line}: a supply is either intra-state (CGST + SGST) or inter-state (IGST), not both.
line.discount_invalid: Line {line}: discount {amount} is not a positive amount.
line.discount_exceeds_line: Line {line}: discount {discount} is more than the line's {total}.

roundoff.increment_invalid: Round-off increment {increment} must be more than zero.
roundoff.increment_below_paisa: Round-off increment {increment} is smaller than a paisa.
roundoff.mode_invalid: Round-off mode "{mode}" is not one of nearest, up, down.

csv.unterminated_quote: Unterminated quoted field starting on line {line}. A quote was opened and never closed, so the rest of the file cannot be read.

catalogue.missing_columns: The file is missing required column(s): {missing}. Expected headings: {expected}.
catalogue.ambiguous_slab: Two tax slabs are in force at the same rate ({slab}). Close one before importing.

issue.field_count: has {actual} values but the heading has {expected} — a comma inside a name needs the value wrapped in double quotes
issue.barcode_duplicate_in_file: already used on line {line} of this file
issue.barcode_in_system: already on a product in the system
issue.rate_no_slab_in_force: no GST slab in force at this rate
issue.money_invalid: not a money amount (digits, optionally with up to 2 decimal places)
issue.sale_price_above_mrp: higher than mrp ({mrp}) — MRP is a legal maximum
issue.unit_unknown: not a unit in the units master
issue.quantity_invalid: not a quantity (digits, optionally up to 3 decimal places)
